modelDefinition.name: PlexPart
modelDefinition.description: Vendor-shaped projection of PartDTO from /mdm/v2/parts. Generated from the PLEX dictionary 2026-08-05, not hand-written. Read-only evidence: every field is nullable because a vendor's required flag describes their write contract, not what their read endpoint returns. Harmonization happens in the hub tenant.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary id (== dedupeKey). Ours, not the vendor's.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The part number.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The part name.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: The part revision.

fields.name: description
fields.description: The description of the part.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The part type. Setup Table: Part_Type.

fields.name: group
fields.description: The part group. Setup Table: Part_Group.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The part source, which represents the origin of the part. Setup Table: Part_Source.

fields.name: productType
fields.description: The part's product type. Setup Table: Part_Product_Type.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The status of the part. Setup Table: Part_Status.

fields.name: note
fields.description: A note about the part.

fields.name: leadTimeDays
fields.description: The number of days in advance to schedule orders for the part.

fields.name: buildingCode
fields.description: The main building where the part is located. Application: Buildings.

fields.name: createdById
fields.description: The IAM account ID of the user who created the part record.

fields.name: createdDateTime
fields.description: The date and time on which the part record was created.

fields.name: modifiedById
fields.description: The IAM account ID of the user who last modified the part record.

fields.name: modifiedDateTime
fields.description: The date and time on which the part record was last modified.

fields.name: allergens
fields.description: Allergen(s) defined on the part. Setup Table: Allergen. Allergen values are only returned when the HACCP module or the Storage Validation module is enabled.

fields.name: storageConditions
fields.description: The storage condition(s) defined on the part. Setup Table: Storage_Condition. Storage condition values are only returned when the Storage Validation module is enabled.

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: Native key in the source system. Half of the upsert key, so a re-extract overwrites rather than duplicates.

fields.name: sourceSystemId
fields.description: FK to ExternalSystem — WHICH instance of this ERP said so. Two sites running the same vendor are two systems, and their keys collide by construction.

fields.name: sourceSystem
fields.description:
The registered source system this row came from. A REAL relation, not a bare id: it makes `row.sourceSystem { name }` traversable and makes the platform reject a source system that does not exist — which is the difference between catching a mistyped system on the first row and discovering it after a million rows have landed under a name nobody recognises.

     One-way by design. ExternalSystem is a platform/ACE model this generator does not own, so it gets no reverse collection — and a collection of several thousand vendor models hanging off one registry row would be unusable anyway.

fields.name: sourceUrl
fields.description: Collection endpoint this row was read from, so a suspect field can be traced to the contract that produced it.

fields.name: sourceVersion
fields.description: Dictionary stamp this model was generated from. A vendor schema change shows up here before it shows up as a bug.

fields.name: syncedAt
fields.description: When this row was last read from the source.

fields.name: rawPayload
fields.description: The verbatim vendor record. Stays in the SPOKE tenant — feature bundles cross to the hub, raw payloads never do.

fields.name: dedupeKey
fields.description: sourceSystemId:externalId — the idempotency key.
